headline: Kapston Services reports a disposal of shares under SEBI takeover regulations
hook: Stake reduction in Kapston Services Limited
summary: Kapston Services Limited has disclosed a disposal of shares pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations. This regulatory filing indicates a change in shareholding structure by a substantial shareholder or promoter. Such disclosures are routine compliance measures under SEBI norms. Retail investors should track ownership shifts as they can impact stock liquidity and governance.
why_it_matters: Shareholding shifts may affect stock liquidity.

headline: Kapston Services reports standard insider trading regulation disclosure
hook: Routine insider trading disclosure filed by Kapston
summary: Kapston Services Limited has submitted a routine continual disclosure to the stock exchange pursuant to Regulation 7(2) read with Regulation 6(2) of SEBI insider trading norms. Such filings are procedural updates regarding shareholding changes by designated persons or promoters. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing with no immediate financial impact on the company's operations or earnings. Indian retail investors tracking the stock should note this as routine administrative compliance.
why_it_matters: Standard compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
